entries.title: Leviticus 27:1
segments: ¶Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 27:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When a man consecrates by a vow certain persons to the LORD, according to your valuation,

entries.title: Leviticus 27:3
segments: 'if your valuation is of a male from twenty years old up to sixty years old, then your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:4
segments: 'If it [is] a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels;

entries.title: Leviticus 27:5
segments: 'and if from five years old up to twenty years old, then your valuation for a male shall be twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels;

entries.title: Leviticus 27:6
segments: 'and if from a month old up to five years old, then your valuation for a male shall be five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver;

entries.title: Leviticus 27:7
segments: 'and if from sixty years old and above, if [it is] a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:8
segments: 'But if he is too poor to pay your valuation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall set a value for him; according to the ability of him who vowed, the priest shall value him.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:9
segments: 'If [it is] an animal that men may bring as an offering to the LORD, all that [anyone] gives to the LORD shall be holy.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:10
segments: 'He shall not substitute it or exchange it, good for bad or bad for good; and if he at all exchanges animal for animal, then both it and the one exchanged for it shall be holy.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:11
segments: 'If [it is] an unclean animal which they do not offer as a sacrifice to the LORD, then he shall present the animal before the priest;

entries.title: Leviticus 27:12
segments: 'and the priest shall set a value for it, whether it is good or bad; as you, the priest, value it, so it shall be.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:13
segments: 'But if he [wants] at all [to] redeem it, then he must add one-fifth to your valuation.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:14
segments: ¶'And when a man dedicates his house [to be] holy to the LORD, then the priest shall set a value for it, whether it is good or bad; as the priest values it, so it shall stand.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:15
segments: 'If he who dedicated it [wants to] redeem his house, then he must add one-fifth of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:16
segments: 'If a man dedicates to the LORD [part] of a field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. A homer of barley seed [shall be valued] at fifty shekels of silver.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:17
segments: 'If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:18
segments: 'But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money due according to the years that remain till the Year of Jubilee, and it shall be deducted from your valuation.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:19
segments: 'And if he who dedicates the field ever wishes to redeem it, then he must add one-fifth of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall belong to him.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:20
segments: 'But if he does not want to redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed anymore;

entries.title: Leviticus 27:21
segments: 'but the field, when it is released in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field; it shall be the possession of the priest.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:22
segments: 'And if a man dedicates to the LORD a field which he has bought, which is not the field of his possession,

entries.title: Leviticus 27:23
segments: 'then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation, up to the Year of Jubilee, and he shall give your valuation on that day [as] a holy [offering] to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:24
segments: 'In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, to the one who [owned] the land as a possession.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:25
segments: 'And all your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:26
segments: ¶'But the firstborn of the animals, which should be the LORD'S firstborn, no man shall dedicate; whether [it is] an ox or sheep, it [is] the LORD'S.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:27
segments: 'And if [it is] an unclean animal, then he shall redeem [it] according to your valuation, and shall add one-fifth to it; or if it is not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:28
segments: 'Nevertheless no devoted [offering] that a man may devote to the LORD of all that he has, [both] man and beast, or the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed; every devoted [offering is] most holy to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:29
segments: 'No person under the ban, who may become doomed to destruction among men, shall be redeemed, [but] shall surely be put to death.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:30
segments: 'And all the tithe of the land, [whether] of the seed of the land [or] of the fruit of the tree, [is] the LORD'S. It [is] holy to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:31
segments: 'If a man wants at all to redeem [any] of his tithes, he shall add one-fifth to it.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:32
segments: 'And concerning the tithe of the herd or the flock, of whatever passes under the rod, the tenth one shall be holy to the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 27:33
segments: 'He shall not inquire whether it is good or bad, nor shall he exchange it; and if he exchanges it at all, then both it and the one exchanged for it shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.'"

entries.title: Leviticus 27:34
segments: These [are] the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.
